jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description: Designed and implemented a modular fault detection engine for CIGRE-MV power networks using Python and random forest ensembles.
bullets: Architected a multi-tier random forest ensemble in Python using object-oriented principles, reaching 92% fault detection and 100% fault localization accuracy.
Synthesized more than 21,000 labeled power grid scenarios with pandapower to strengthen the supervised learning dataset.
Replaced the Newton-Raphson solver with an optimized DLPF-based implementation, reducing voltage computation time by 70%.
Managed iterative prototyping and validation for a fault detection engine targeting real-time inference needs.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description: Worked on backend for developing invoice generation modules for internal prototypes.
bullets: Built a React frontend with MUI components, Redux Toolkit for state management, and React Context API for real-time data synchronization.
Implemented code-split routing using lazy loading to improve performance and loading behavior.
Generated structured PDF invoices averaging about 2ms per document via PDFKit with streamed HTTP delivery.
Reduced p95 response time from 1.97s to 19ms by fixing an unbounded query and adding server-side pagination.
